scope: 345 guidance sections + 85 MedQuAD evidence + 14 optional MedMCQA items; no evaluation or smoke records
thresholdOrigin: Thresholds selected after an exploratory lexical preflight; not a semantic validation threshold.
handling: No equivalence established. Keep every unconfirmed overlap and every population, disease, dose, region, version or layer variant separate. Never merge threshold edges or cross-layer pairs.
review: Codex lexical/context inspection, not clinical or exhaustive semantic validation. No remote model calls.
